The '''Model 8 Cargo Platform''' was a [[Repulsorcart/Legends|repulsorcart]] manufactured by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]]. It was a no-frills model and affordable to [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].<ref name="PSG" />
